description: Source code for a tool that processes root certificate store data, reads protobuf root store files, decodes PEM certificates, and generates C++ header files with embedded certificate data and EV metadata.

methods.name: DecodeCerts
methods.description: Decodes PEM-encoded certificates from input string, returns a map of SHA-256 hex hashes to DER certificates.

methods.name: ReadTextRootStore
methods.description: Reads and parses a protobuf root store file, replaces trust anchor certificates with actual DER data from provided PEM certificates, and validates the data.

methods.name: WriteRootCppFile
methods.description: Generates a C++ header file with embedded DER certificates from the root store.

methods.name: WriteEvCppFile
methods.description: Generates a C++ header file with EV metadata for trust anchors.
